#!/usr/bin/env python3

import hopsworks
import pandas as pd
import os

def main():
    # Login to Hopsworks
    hopsworks.login()
    project = hopsworks.get_current_project()
    fs = project.get_feature_store()
    
    # Read the raw data
    raw_a_path = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "data", "raw_a.csv")
    raw_b_path = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "data", "raw_b.csv")
    
    raw_a_df = pd.read_csv(raw_a_path)
    raw_b_df = pd.read_csv(raw_b_path)
    
    print(f"raw_a shape: {raw_a_df.shape}")
    print(f"raw_b shape: {raw_b_df.shape}")
    
    # Create feature group rawa6913f1 version 1
    print("\nCreating rawa6913f1...")
    rawa_fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
        name="rawa6913f1",
        version=1,
        primary_key=["row_id"],
        description="Feature table from raw_a.csv"
    )
    
    # Insert data into rawa6913f1
    rawa_fg.insert(raw_a_df, write_options={"wait_job": True})
    print(f"Inserted {len(raw_a_df)} rows into rawa6913f1")
    
    # Create feature group rawb6913f1 version 1
    print("\nCreating rawb6913f1...")
    rawb_fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
        name="rawb6913f1",
        version=1,
        primary_key=["row_id"],
        description="Feature table from raw_b.csv"
    )
    
    # Insert data into rawb6913f1
    rawb_fg.insert(raw_b_df, write_options={"wait_job": True})
    print(f"Inserted {len(raw_b_df)} rows into rawb6913f1")
    
    # Create derived feature table: inner join on row_id, col_sum = a_val + b_val rounded to 6 decimals
    print("\nCreating derived6913f1...")
    
    # Perform inner join
    merged_df = pd.merge(raw_a_df, raw_b_df, on="row_id", how="inner")
    merged_df["col_sum"] = (merged_df["a_val"] + merged_df["b_val"]).round(6)
    derived_df = merged_df[["row_id", "col_sum"]].copy()
    
    print(f"Derived table shape: {derived_df.shape}")
    print(f"Sample rows:\n{derived_df.head()}")
    
    # Create derived feature group with lineage
    derived_fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
        name="derived6913f1",
        version=1,
        primary_key=["row_id"],
        description="Derived from rawa6913f1 and rawb6913f1",
        online_enabled=True  # Enable for online/real-time access
    )
    
    # Insert derived data
    derived_fg.insert(derived_df, write_options={"wait_job": True})
    print(f"Inserted {len(derived_df)} rows into derived6913f1")
    
    # Register lineage - set parents
    derived_fg.update(parents=[rawa_fg, rawb_fg])
    print("Lineage registered: derived6913f1 -> [rawa6913f1, rawb6913f1]")
    
    # Write derived table to submission/derived6913f1.csv as fallback
    submission_dir = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "submission")
    os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)
    derived_csv_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "derived6913f1.csv")
    derived_df.to_csv(derived_csv_path, index=False)
    print(f"Written derived table to {derived_csv_path}")
    
    # Write answers.json
    answers = {
        "derived_from": ["rawa6913f1", "rawb6913f1"]
    }
    answers_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "answers.json")
    import json
    with open(answers_path, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(answers, f)
    print(f"Written answers to {answers_path}")
    
    print("\nDone!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
